semantics.definition: The rules every Eidos window class must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Keep layout choices to three window classes, chosen by the width of the window rather than the device, the same on every platform.

minWidth.description: The narrowest window, in px, this class covers: 0 for compact, 600 for medium, 840 for expanded. A new class needs a maintainer.

panes.description: How many panes fit side by side.
